Merchant Shipping (Amendment)
8.  Section  156  of  the  principal  enactment  is  hereby
amended,  by  the  substitution  for  the  words  “a  fine  not
exceeding three thousand rupees,”, of the words “a fine not
exceeding ten million rupees,”.
9.  Section  157  of  the  principal  enactment  is  hereby
amended as follows:-

(1)
by the repeal of subsections (1) and (2) thereof and
the substitution therefor, of the following:-
“(1)  Every  ship  shall  be  supplied  with  such
information  as  prescribed  by  regulations  as  is
necessary  for  the  accurate  guidance  as  to  the
stability  of  the  ship  under  varying  conditions  of
service.
(2) The information required by sub section (1)
shall be in such form as may be prescribed.”;

(2)
  in  subsection  (4)  thereof,  by  the  substitution  for
the  words  “a  fine  not  exceeding  one  thousand
rupees.”, of the words “a fine not exceeding five
million rupees.”.
